allocation_impact: Validate UTF-8 and byte length <=63 from the bounded message before creating an owned field-name String or statement-metadata name backing.
boundary_tests: 63 UTF-8 bytes accepted when the complete RowDescription and aggregate-name limits also pass
64 UTF-8 bytes rejected as UNAVAILABLE before owned field-name allocation

notes: Owner-selected stock PostgreSQL 18.6 compatibility ceiling. It is not a protocol-wide invariant; support for a build with larger NAMEDATALEN/max_identifier_length requires an explicit successor decision.
